exact_old_text: **Spirits May Yet Dream** can flip any Fear Card, earned or anywhere in the deck.
exact_proposed_new_text: **Spirits May Yet Dream** may turn any face-down Fear Card face-up, whether already earned or anywhere in the deck. This only previews the card: turning it face-up neither earns it nor resolves its Fear effect early; normal earning and resolution still apply.
primary_authority: Original Bringer front, Spirits May Yet Dream first-threshold parenthetical
